notes.title: MAJOR Update - 4 Playable Superheroes
notes.notes:
The game now has 4 playable superheroes, each with their own unique and epic superpowers and mechanics!

Hope you enjoy!!!!

notes.title: Better Punching Update
notes.notes:
I have fixed bugs in the punching mechanic, and now every NPC can be punched.

I have also added ATM Machines you can laser to pieces and steal money from!

...and more destructible toys.

notes.title: 'Punching Civilians' Update
notes.notes: As per community request, I have added a Punching mechanic to Civilians, now you can punch them into the air and laser them to bits!

notes.title: Major Update 5
notes.notes: Menu and Tutorial Map have been added, as well as an optimized level for Less Powerful PCs.

notes.title: Update Notes for patch 5
notes.notes: Due to community request, the Superhero Gloves have been updated to a much cooler model that looks far better.
